Ape Escape Gameplay Assist Pack (v1.1.0)

Each assist is a separate opt-in feature on the launcher's Mods page. All
features start disabled. Infinite Lives, Infinite Health, Infinite Air,
Unlock All Gadgets, and Unlock All Stages are applied only during active
gameplay. Infinite Health replenishes health; it does not make every level
hazard harmless.

Unlock All Stages sets zero-valued stage-status entries to 1, unlocking the
stages while preserving existing nonzero status values and completion progress.
